T0573.title: Model Hallucination
T0573.definition: A model output that appears plausible but is unsupported, incorrect, fabricated, or misleading.
T0573.description: Model hallucination produces plausible but unsupported, false, fabricated, or misleading content. In support, compliance, finance, and security-analysis workflows, it can drive wrong decisions. Mitigation requires citations, retrieval grounding, confidence signals, factual verification, and human review for high-impact outputs.
T0573.usageExample: Assess Model Hallucination related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
